items.title: Moorhead Steps Down As Football Head CoacH
items.summary: AKRON, Ohio — Joe Moorhead has stepped down from his position as football head coach at The University of Akron to pursue other opportunities, Director of Athletics Dr. Andrew T. Goodrich announced on Friday, Nov. 27, 2026.

items.title: Gant Makes History as Akron Falls to Buffalo in Season Finale
items.summary: AKRON, Ohio — Jordan Gant etched his name into the University of Akron football record book Friday, eclipsing 1,000 rushing yards for the second consecutive season as the Zips dropped a 17-9 decision to Buffalo in their season finale at a snow-covered InfoCision Stadium – Summa Health Field.

items.title: Akron Rallies Past UMass, 34-33, to Snap Eight-Game Skid
items.summary: AMHERST, Mass. — Jordan Gant rushed for 151 yards and two touchdowns, Brandon Hills returned a kickoff 100 yards for a score and Aidan Stire kicked the go-ahead field goal in the fourth quarter as Akron rallied for a 34-33 victory over Massachusetts on Wednesday night at McGuirk Alumni Stadium.

items.title: Football At UMass For Wednesday MACTion
Broughton, Williams Connect Twice in Akron's Setback to Western Michigan
items.summary: AKRON, Ohio — Cibastian Broughton threw a pair of touchdown passes to Marcel Williams, while Tairan Davis recorded a game-high 15 tackles, as Akron fell to Western Michigan, 42-14, in Mid-American Conference action Tuesday night at InfoCision Stadium — Summa Health Field.

items.title: Akron Pushes MAC-Leading Ohio Before Falling 28-20 on Tuesday Night
items.summary: AKRON, Ohio — The first Tuesday in November had a little bit of everything as MACtion kicked off with the University of Akron putting a scare into Mid-American Conference-leading Ohio before falling short in a 28-20 setback at InfoCision Stadium — Summa Health Field on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

items.title: Football's Clash With Ohio To Be Televised On ESPN2
items.summary: AKRON, Ohio — University of Akron football will kick off November with a 7 p.m. start against Ohio from InfoCision Stadium — Summa Field on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

items.title: Football Comes Up Short In 69th Battle For The Wagon Wheel
items.summary: KENT, Ohio — Jordan Gant rushed for 162 yards and two touchdowns, and Akron outgained Kent State 422-376, but the Golden Flashes pulled away in the fourth quarter for a 35-20 victory in the 69th Battle for the Wagon Wheel on Saturday afternoon at Dix Stadium.

items.title: Football Downed By Miami (OH) 34-14
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio — The University of Akron football team opened Saturday's Mid-American Conference matchup with an impressive 97-yard touchdown drive, but four turnovers and Miami's explosive rushing attack proved too much to overcome as the Zips dropped a 34-14 decision to the RedHawks at Yager Stadium.
